purpose: Teach: 言いよう/腐っ/しつこく/概ね/受けとめ/取り消し/ふたたび/大嫌い

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の言いよう、面白すぎるぜ
lines.en: Riku, your way of saying things is hilarious.
lines.style: Bright, teasing laugh underneath. Quick delivery. The warmth of genuinely finding him funny, not performing the tease. Slight lean into it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、給食のお肉、腐ってないだろうな、桜
lines.en: The cafeteria meat isn't actually rotting, is it, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry, understated. Like he's asking something obvious but needs to check anyway. Eyes steady on her face, almost innocent. A beat before he speaks.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、しつこく勧誘するなよ
lines.en: Riku, stop pushing me on this.
lines.style: Firm but not sharp. A warning wrapped in patience. She means it but she's not angry yet. Steady eye contact, no room for negotiation in her tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト範囲、概ね頭に入ったか?桜
lines.en: Did most of the test material actually stick, Sakura?
lines.style: Careful check-in. Quiet, like he's gathering information before deciding something. Slight uncertainty in his voice—he cares about the answer more than he's letting on.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ぼくのアドバイス素直に受けとめろよ
lines.en: Riku, actually listen to what I'm telling you.
lines.style: Quieter than before. The frustration has shifted to something more serious. She's stopped teasing. Direct, almost pleading underneath the firmness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、約束の取り消しはダメだぜ、桜
lines.en: You can't just back out of what you promised, Sakura.
lines.style: Holds steady. Not angry but immovable. The voice of someone who doesn't say things twice. A slight edge underneath the calm—this matters.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、ふたたびぼくと一緒に遊ぼうな
lines.en: Riku, come play with me again, okay?
lines.style: Shift in temperature. Warmer, more open. The teasing drops. There's a genuine invitation underneath—she's offering something. Slight vulnerability in how she asks.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、数学が大嫌いって言ってたな、桜
lines.en: You said you hated math, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet observation. He's remembering something she said, holding it gently. Not accusatory—just accurate. The voice of someone paying close attention. Trails slightly.
